common.title: Knowledge Work Is Boosted, Not Replaced
common.line: The evidence arrives from ordinary offices rather than from laboratories: measured productivity gains in law, accountancy, administration, journalism and consulting, largest among the least experienced, and no matching fall in employment.

notable.title: Anti ai sabotage wave
notable.line: Coordinated physical sabotage against data centres and municipal AI systems across several member states by anti-dependence activists, forcing temporary shutdowns and a policing response.

notable.title: Care failure litigation
notable.line: Municipal hospital networks forced offline by the ransomware sweep publish patient-safety near-miss dossiers, triggering coordinated clinician-led lawsuits against vendors and the state across several member states.

notable.title: Datacentre backlash
notable.line: Municipal blackouts and rogue-agent failures trigger coordinated physical blockades of planned data-centre sites, delaying construction and forcing a siting moratorium debate.
